En: Separately downloaded five-file bundle: Distilled INT8 ConvRot, the LTX-specific Gemma4 encoder with projections, Conv video VAE, audio VAE and spatial upscaler. The INT8 files target ComfyUI; executor code and dependencies have separate terms and are not installed at this stage. The LTX-2.x agreement dated 2026-08-11 includes use and redistribution restrictions: entities with annual revenue of at least USD 10 million, including related entities, require a separate license subject to the original exceptions. Acknowledgement does not grant missing rights. Preserve licenses, attribution, AI-origin disclosure and embedded notices; do not disable watermarking or provenance. The user must personally accept the Hugging Face gated-repository terms and provide Read-token access; acknowledgement in LOPATA does not replace consent at the source.
